maintenance.title: Stonestorm Companion – 0.14.0 BETA
maintenance.compact: Active feature development of Companion is paused at this version. Working features remain available; development continues in the separate Stonestorm Workspace application.
maintenance.body1: Active feature development of Companion is paused at this version. We are currently working on a separate application called Stonestorm Workspace, designed to offer a more convenient way to manage game interfaces and multi-panel layouts.
maintenance.body2: Have an idea or feedback? Feel free to contact me on Discord: pain6089.
maintenance.body3: Companion remains available, and bug fixes may still be released when needed.
